record.paper_title: Structural results on circular-arc graphs and circle graphs: A survey and the main open problems
record.original_question: Find a graph decomposition for Helly circle graphs under which the class of Helly circle graphs is closed, in analogy with the role of split decomposition for circle graphs. A circle graph is the intersection graph of chords on a circle. A Helly circle graph has a circle model whose pairwise different chords satisfy the Helly property: every pairwise intersecting set of chords has a common point. The goal is to identify a decomposition operation that preserves this Helly circle-graph class in the same structural way that split decomposition preserves circle graphs.

evidence.quote: Problem 8. Find a decomposition such that Helly circle graphs are closed under this decomposition.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A circle graph is the intersection graph of a finite family of chords of a circle; such a family is called a circle model of the graph. A circle graph G is called a Helly circle graph if it admits a circle model in which the chords are pairwise distinct and satisfy the Helly property: every subfamily of chords that is pairwise intersecting has a common point.

Recall that the split decomposition of a graph repeatedly decomposes it along splits (partitions (A,B) of the vertex set with |A|,|B| ≥ 2 such that the edges between A and B form a complete bipartite graph between specified subsets), and that the class of circle graphs is closed under split decomposition.

Problem. Define a graph decomposition operation under which the class of Helly circle graphs is closed, in the same structural sense that split decomposition preserves the class of circle graphs. That is, exhibit a decomposition such that a graph is a Helly circle graph if and only if all of its prime components (with respect to this decomposition) are Helly circle graphs.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface results on Helly circular-arc graphs and their decompositions, but no source explicitly resolves the analogous question for Helly circle graphs (chords on a circle with the Helly property). No decomposition operation under which the Helly circle graph class is closed appears to be established in the accessible literature, so the status is unclear.

status_evidence.title: Circular-arc graphs and the Helly property
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Helly property in circular-arc representations but does not address a decomposition for Helly circle graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on Helly representations focuses on circular-arc graphs rather than identifying a decomposition closing the Helly circle graph class.

status_evidence.title: Helly circular arc graphs (graphclasses.org)
status_evidence.snippet: Catalog entry on Helly circular-arc graphs; no mention of a decomposition theorem for Helly circle graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Standard graph class catalogs do not record a decomposition operation under which Helly circle graphs are closed.
